title: Read the places our routes use beyond home twice in a turn: deposits, creatures, order books, mission boards
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-16 23:21 UTC (orders.log ENT-019, block ORACLE: the places our routes use are read twice in a turn). The list: every system outside the ten Voidborn systems that a route of any plan names (game/routes/plans/*.json, each route file a mine, hunt or circuit stop of), 30 systems: 28 lawless ones of census-frontier and the Solarian systems Nova Terra and Sirius, where our gas and hunt routes sell (rule F3: anywhere in the galaxy). Every 120 minutes, so a field, a herd or a book the fleet plans on is never older than about two hours; a frontier read took a median of 14.4 minutes over 165 runs (data/routes/runs.jsonl). Empty hold on the way out (rule F13). Flown by the scouts only; census-frontier keeps the systems no route uses for every plan. At 2026-11-16 23:26 UTC the 8 systems Military reads every 60 minutes on census-guard-ice (ruchbah, achernar, wolf_1061, gsc_0041, alnair, keid, intercrus, antares) left this list, so no system is read by two routes of ours: 22 systems remain. It takes the place of census-route-places (written 2026-11-16 18:31 UTC, never in a plan), which is off. every_minutes 120 -> 90 by Oracle at 2026-11-17 03:54 UTC: only 9 of its 22 systems were read twice in the 4 hours to 03:53 UTC and its oldest read stood at 145 minutes, while 20 scouts flew 45-minute gather runs: a threshold at the target lands every read after it (knowledge of the census: the threshold sits below the target by the longest wait). 2026-11-17 11:25 UTC, Oracle: atlas, botein, cedarhold moved to census-watch-gsc-0044 (every 60 minutes; orders.log ENT-036, P4 a), so that the lists stay disjoint. Changed by Oracle 2026-11-17 19:26 UTC: clearwater added from census-watch-clearwater (off): Logistics gathers silicon there (gather-glasslight-shoal-silicon).
